resources.string: About %1$s compatibility
Where can this information appear?
Storage in Contako
The field stays in the contact when you save. Opening this help does not save, change or send anything.
Proton support
Supported formats can be sent to Proton. Normal field validation still applies; this is not a delivery confirmation.
This value stays local and is not generated in Proton. Its intentional absence there is not a synchronization error.
Imported unknown vCard properties are read-only and retained during compatible edits. This is not support for freely editing or converting them.
Compatibility is undetermined. The information stays preserved; no conversion is performed by this help.
The value and its label have different support: this custom label stays local. That does not make the entire value local-only.
Android representation
The current mapping can represent each supported occurrence in Android.
Android uses the primary occurrence for this field or its structured row. Other occurrences stay in Contako and follow their own Proton support.
Contako does not project this field into a standard Android contact row. It stays preserved according to its Contako and Proton support.
This occurrence is included in the theoretical projection. That does not prove it has been copied or verified.
This occurrence is not included in the current projection. It is not removed from Contako.
Android copying is currently suspended without Contacts permission. Format support and allowed local/Proton editing remain unchanged.
The original photo and Android copy may use different representations. A thumbnail or similar appearance never proves original equality. This help does not download referenced media.
Visibility in contact apps
Visibility and editing vary between contact apps and are not verified here. A represented field can still be hidden by an editor.
These are support rules, not synchronization results. Check the saved contact synchronization status for actual confirmations and pending work.
Proton assignments belong to each email occurrence and depend on account capability. Opening this help does not probe the account.
Email-group changes: known available from a previous successful operation.
Email-group changes: explicitly refused by Proton for the current account context.
Email-group changes: availability unknown. Offline state or subscription name cannot establish it.
This is the preferred email. Android uses its group assignments.
This is a secondary email. Its own Proton groups stay separate; Android uses the preferred email groups.
Android groups come from the preferred email, not the union of all email assignments.
Unrecognized Android MIME rows stay in Android. They are not promoted into Contako or Proton by this help.
Local value, no Proton transfer
Preserved, read-only
No Android projection
Android uses the primary occurrence
Groups belong to each email
Some labels stay local
